title: OpenCode 2.0 Transforms AI Coding Agent into Programmable Platform
summary:
A single shared background service now powers the terminal, desktop and web interfaces of the latest software update from OpenCode. This version introduces 'Code Mode,' which enables agents to write JavaScript to combine MCP tools and APIs to minimize tool-call overhead and context bloat. It also adds background agents capable of running shell commands and subagents asynchronously while the user continues to work.

The software includes a redesigned API for session management and over 80 internal plugins, featuring TUI extensions with hot reloading. With the release of a new SDK for building custom coding agents and interfaces, the project transitions from a simple interactive assistant into a fully programmable development platform that can write and load its own plugins.

selectedTweets.text:
OpenCode 2.0 is here, with a massive overhaul of the open-source AI coding agent!

The biggest architectural change is a single background service shared by the terminal, desktop and web interfaces. But there's much more:

• Code Mode: Agents can write JavaScript to combine MCP tools and APIs, reducing tool-call overhead and context bloat.
• Background agents: Run subagents and shell commands asynchronously while you keep working.
• New API: Completely redesigned for more powerful session management and orchestration.
• Plugins: Over 80 internal plugins, TUI extensions and hot reloading. OpenCode can even write and load its own plugins!
• New SDK: Build custom coding agents and interfaces on top of OpenCode.

OpenCode is evolving from an interactive coding assistant into a fully programmable development platform.
